title: Interface-Led Architecture and the Riemann Hypothesis: A System-Governance Heuristic for Prime Distribution and Dynamic Equilibrium
description: This technical note presents a conceptual and heuristic system-governance interpretation of the Riemann Hypothesis through Interface-Led Architecture. It does not claim to prove the Riemann Hypothesis. The paper maps primes to oscillatory Providers, zeta zeros to cancellation contracts, and the critical line to a governance boundary between divergent and over-damped prime-mode phases. English is the canonical version; Japanese is included as a companion translation.
